tasks.label: db: check
tasks.detail: Verify PostgreSQL is reachable on localhost:5432. Never starts it: on the maintainer's machine the development database lives in a shared container another project owns — so this task only checks and tells you what to start yourself. See docs/postgres-setup-dev.md.
tasks.command: timeout 2 bash -c 'exec 3<>/dev/tcp/localhost/5432' 2>/dev/null || { echo 'PostgreSQL is NOT reachable on localhost:5432. See docs/postgres-setup-dev.md for which container to start.'; exit 1; }

tasks.label: client: install
tasks.detail: npm ci in src/Homon.Web when node_modules is absent. The .NET build never touches the SPA, so a fresh clone needs this before the Vite dev server can start.

tasks.label: client: build
tasks.detail: tsc -b && vite build — type-checks the SPA and emits dist/. Not needed to run the dev server; this is the verification gate.

tasks.label: build: solution
tasks.detail: dotnet build Homon.sln. Also the formatting gate — IDE0055 is an error and TreatWarningsAsErrors is on, because dotnet format is broken on this SDK.

tasks.label: dev: prepare
tasks.detail: Everything that must happen before the hosts start: confirm the database is reachable, restore the SPA's dependencies if missing, then build the solution. Aborts the launch if PostgreSQL is down.

tasks.label: client: dev server
tasks.detail: Vite dev server on http://localhost:5300 with HMR, proxying /api to Kestrel on :5301. Background task — use this when you want Vite in a plain terminal instead of the 'Dev: full stack with HMR' compound.

tasks.label: api: test
tasks.detail: dotnet test Homon.sln — xUnit on VSTest. Database-backed tests skip unless HOMON_TEST_CONNECTION is set; ./ci/run-ci.sh api is the run that proves them.
